items.sentence: Grown children can no longer count on their parents to take care of their babies, since their parents are working just as hard as they are.
items.prompt: 문장 끝 they are 뒤에 의미상 반복되어 생략된 말을 입력하세요.
items.explanation: 원급 비교의 두 번째 as 뒤에서는 앞 절의 반복어구가 생략될 수 있습니다. they are working hard가 완전한 형태입니다.
items.memory: as + 형용사/부사 + as + S + 조동사/be → 뒤 반복어구 복원

items.sentence: When you make a presentation, your final words should be as clear as the message on an advertisement in a national magazine is.
items.prompt: 문장 끝 is 뒤에 의미상 생략된 보어를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: as clear as ... is clear에서 반복되는 clear가 생략된 구조입니다.

items.sentence: With the wrong attitude, we would spend more time on identifying what's wrong with other people and ourselves than we would on identifying what's right.
items.prompt: than절의 would 뒤에 의미상 생략된 동사구를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: 앞 절의 spend more time이 반복되므로 than절에서는 핵심 동사구가 생략되어 있습니다.

items.sentence: Jina studies longer than her brother does.
items.explanation: 비교절의 does는 앞의 일반동사 studies의 반복을 대신합니다.
